html:
The Battle of Midway was a naval battle fought from 4 to 7 June 1942 near Midway Atoll in the central Pacific. American carrier aircraft sank four Japanese aircraft carriers, and it turned the Pacific War.

Admiral Yamamoto planned to take Midway and lure the American fleet into a decisive battle. But the Navy's codebreakers at Station Hypo had read enough of the Japanese naval code to know the target and the timing. Admiral Nimitz placed his carriers ready to ambush.

On 4 June dive bombers from the American carriers caught the Japanese carriers while their decks were full of planes being refuelled and rearmed. Three were destroyed within minutes, and a fourth sank later that day. The United States lost one carrier, Yorktown.

Japan lost many of its best pilots and ships, and its power to attack was gone. From then on the Allies held the initiative.
